input.text: Only a manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements.
input.heading: Policy statements

document.title: Customer Identification Policy
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Do not open an account until you have verified two forms of identification for each signer, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.
input.heading: Additional requirements

document.title: Customer Identification Policy
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Consumer debit cards can withdraw up to $800 a day at ATMs.
input.heading: Additional requirements

input.text: The daily ATM withdrawal limit for consumer debit cards is $800.
input.heading: Additional requirements

input.text: Customers have 60 days from the statement date to dispute a debit card transaction, or longer when the customer was traveling or hospitalized.
input.heading: Additional requirements

document.title: Debit Card Dispute Policy
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Replacement debit cards arrive within 7 business days of the request.
input.heading: Additional requirements

document.title: Debit Card Dispute Policy
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: A personal banker can waive no more than $25 for one account in a calendar year, or up to $50 with branch manager approval noted in the account.
input.heading: Policy statements

document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Never destroy a record that is under a legal hold.
input.heading: Additional requirements

document.title: Funds Availability Policy
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Each item paid into overdraft is charged $30.
input.heading: Policy statements

document.title: Overdraft Policy

input.text: No overdraft fee is charged when the account is overdrawn by $10 or less at the end of the day.
